issue.title: Enforce QA-required PR merge gate (status/label/checklist)
issue.body:
## Summary

Follow-up from #329. Docs now define a **manual** merge gate: QA-required PRs must not merge until QA passes that PR’s isolated `preview-build`.

This ticket is to **automate or hard-enforce** that gate once the team agrees on the mechanism.

## Options to consider

- Required GitHub status check / Action that fails until a `qa-passed` label (or similar) is present
- Branch protection rule + CODEOWNERS for QA-required paths
- Checklist bot that blocks merge when Needs QA? = Yes and preview/QA not confirmed
- Project 4 Status must be `Passed QA` before merge (harder to enforce in GitHub alone)

## Out of scope

- Changing the preview build pipeline itself (already isolates per-PR APKs)
- Production `v*` / nightly paths

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Team picks an enforcement mechanism
- [ ] Mechanism documented in `docs/guides/qa-process.md`
- [ ] QA-required PRs cannot merge without evidence of QA pass on that PR’s preview (or explicit maintainer override documented)

## Related

- Part of / blocked by process docs in #329
- `docs/guides/qa-process.md` § Gap (manual gate)

comments.body:
Per current `docs/guides/qa-process.md`, pre-merge QA gating is **superseded** (merge on engineer approval + green CI; QA is post-merge on nightly).

Recommend closing this issue as **not planned** / superseded rather than implementing a merge-blocking QA gate. Tracked from A+ process work on #365.

If Product explicitly wants merge-blocking QA again, reopen with a new AC that matches that policy.
